title: Align remaining raw queue counts with the delivery-history rule (Codex re-archive compensation, actionableQueuedCount)
outcome: Callers that decide whether a session has queued work use the shared delivery-history rule (backend session_has_runnable_queued_prompt / queued_prompt_is_delivery_history; UI runnableQueuedPrompts), so a queue holding only settled delivery history does not block Codex delegation re-archive compensation (src/codex_delegation_release.rs rearchive_undispatched_codex_child, raw queued_prompts.is_empty()) and AgentSessionPanel's actionableQueuedCount uses the same history test as the shared rule (today it counts rejected rows and excludes handingOff ones). Found by the Claude reviewer (delegation-788c90ad) of the historical-queue-row fix; outside that change's scope; neither reproduces its reported symptoms.
acceptance: Align remaining raw queue counts with the delivery-history rule (Codex re-archive compensation, actionableQueuedCount) is done
